name: tortie
description: Tortie — a calm, durable place for agentic work: named terminal sessions that outlive the window (private tmux server), git sidebar, decorated file tree, diff + edit surfaces.
author: Itavero

scripts.build: electron-vite build && node build/assert-bundle-refusals.mjs && node build/assert-preview-containment.mjs
scripts.smoke: npm run build && GMUX_TMUX_SOCKET="${GMUX_TMUX_SOCKET:-gmux-smoke-t1}" GMUX_SMOKE=basic electron . --user-data-dir="${TMPDIR:-/tmp/}gmux-smoke-t1" -ApplePersistenceIgnoreState YES
scripts.smoke:t1: npm run build && node build/harness-socket.mjs gmux-smoke-t1 'npm run smoke:create && npm run smoke:verify'
scripts.smoke:t3: npm run build && node build/harness-socket.mjs gmux-smoke-t3 'GMUX_SMOKE=t3-prep electron . --user-data-dir="${TMPDIR:-/tmp/}gmux-smoke-t3" -ApplePersistenceIgnoreState YES && GMUX_SMOKE=t3-verify electron . --user-data-dir="${TMPDIR:-/tmp/}gmux-smoke-t3" -ApplePersistenceIgnoreState YES'
scripts.smoke:quit: npm run build && node build/harness-socket.mjs gmux-smoke-quit 'GMUX_SMOKE=quit electron . --user-data-dir="${TMPDIR:-/tmp/}gmux-smoke-quit" -ApplePersistenceIgnoreState YES'
scripts.smoke:capture: npm run build && node build/harness-socket.mjs gmux-smoke-capture 'GMUX_SMOKE=capture electron . --user-data-dir="${TMPDIR:-/tmp/}gmux-smoke-capture" -ApplePersistenceIgnoreState YES'
scripts.smoke:migrate: npm run build && node build/harness-socket.mjs gmux-smoke-migrate 'GMUX_SMOKE=migrate electron . --user-data-dir="${TMPDIR:-/tmp/}gmux-smoke-migrate" -ApplePersistenceIgnoreState YES'
scripts.smoke:identity: npm run build && node build/harness-socket.mjs gmux-smoke-identity 'GMUX_SMOKE=identity electron . --user-data-dir="${TMPDIR:-/tmp/}gmux-smoke-identity" -ApplePersistenceIgnoreState YES'
scripts.smoke:reconstruct: npm run build && rm -rf "${TMPDIR:-/tmp/}gmux-smoke-reconstruct" && node build/harness-socket.mjs gmux-smoke-reconstruct 'GMUX_RECONSTRUCT_ROOT="${TMPDIR:-/tmp/}gmux-smoke-reconstruct" GMUX_SMOKE=reconstruct electron . --user-data-dir="${TMPDIR:-/tmp/}gmux-smoke-reconstruct/profile" -ApplePersistenceIgnoreState YES'
scripts.probe:sessionfocus: npm run build && node build/harness-socket.mjs gmux-p801-focus 'node build/probe-session-focus.mjs'
scripts.smoke:power: npm run build && GMUX_POWER_ROOT="${TMPDIR:-/tmp/}gmux-smoke-power" GMUX_TMUX_SOCKET="gmux-power-$$" GMUX_SMOKE=power electron . --user-data-dir="${TMPDIR:-/tmp/}gmux-smoke-power/profile" -ApplePersistenceIgnoreState YES
scripts.smoke:procid: npm run build && node build/harness-socket.mjs gmux-smoke-procid 'GMUX_SMOKE=procid electron . --user-data-dir="${TMPDIR:-/tmp/}gmux-smoke-procid" -ApplePersistenceIgnoreState YES'
scripts.smoke:refusal: npm run build && rm -rf "${TMPDIR:-/tmp/}gmux-smoke-refusal" && GMUX_TMUX_SOCKET=gmux-smoke-refusal GMUX_REFUSAL_ROOT="${TMPDIR:-/tmp/}gmux-smoke-refusal" GMUX_SMOKE=refusal electron . --user-data-dir="${TMPDIR:-/tmp/}gmux-smoke-refusal/profile" -ApplePersistenceIgnoreState YES
scripts.smoke:config: npm run build && rm -rf "${TMPDIR:-/tmp/}gmux-smoke-config" && GMUX_TMUX_SOCKET=gmux-smoke-config GMUX_CONFIG_ROOT="${TMPDIR:-/tmp/}gmux-smoke-config" GMUX_SMOKE=config electron . --user-data-dir="${TMPDIR:-/tmp/}gmux-smoke-config/profile" -ApplePersistenceIgnoreState YES
scripts.smoke:machines: npm run build && rm -rf "${TMPDIR:-/tmp/}gmux-smoke-machines" && GMUX_TMUX_SOCKET=gmux-smoke-machines GMUX_CONFIG_ROOT="${TMPDIR:-/tmp/}gmux-smoke-machines" GMUX_SMOKE=machines electron . --user-data-dir="${TMPDIR:-/tmp/}gmux-smoke-machines/profile" -ApplePersistenceIgnoreState YES
scripts.smoke:partition: npm run build && node build/harness-socket.mjs --fresh gmux-p71-partition 'node build/partition-harness.mjs'
scripts.smoke:matrix: npm run build && node build/harness-socket.mjs --fresh gmux-p72-matrix 'node build/remote-matrix.mjs'
scripts.smoke:remote: npm run build && node build/harness-socket.mjs --fresh gmux-p70-remote 'export GMUX_CONFIG_ROOT="${GMUX_CONFIG_ROOT:-${TMPDIR:-/tmp/}gmux-p70-remote}"; node build/with-scratch-machine.mjs -- GMUX_SMOKE=remote-sessions electron . --user-data-dir=$GMUX_CONFIG_ROOT/profile -ApplePersistenceIgnoreState YES'
scripts.smoke:execplane: npm run build && node build/harness-socket.mjs --fresh gmux-p69-exec 'GMUX_CONFIG_ROOT="${GMUX_CONFIG_ROOT:-${TMPDIR:-/tmp/}gmux-p69-exec}" GMUX_SMOKE=exec-plane electron . --user-data-dir="${GMUX_CONFIG_ROOT:-${TMPDIR:-/tmp/}gmux-p69-exec}/profile" -ApplePersistenceIgnoreState YES'
scripts.conformance:resume: npm run build && node build/harness-socket.mjs gmux-conformance 'GMUX_SMOKE=conformance-resume electron . --user-data-dir="${TMPDIR:-/tmp/}gmux-conformance-resume" -ApplePersistenceIgnoreState YES'
scripts.smoke:t3:shadow: npm run build && node build/harness-socket.mjs gmux-smoke-shadow 'GMUX_SMOKE=shadow electron . --user-data-dir="${TMPDIR:-/tmp/}gmux-smoke-shadow" -ApplePersistenceIgnoreState YES'
scripts.package: electron-vite build && node build/check-tmux-pin.cjs && node build/assert-bundle-refusals.mjs && node build/assert-preview-containment.mjs && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.package:dir: electron-vite build && node build/check-tmux-pin.cjs && node build/assert-bundle-refusals.mjs && node build/assert-preview-containment.mjs && electron-builder --mac --dir
scripts.icon: cp docs/brand/tortie/macos/Tortie.icns build/icon.icns && cp docs/brand/tortie/menu-bar/TortieTemplate.png docs/brand/tortie/menu-bar/TortieTemplate@2x.png resources/menu-bar/ && cp docs/brand/tortie/dock/tortie-dock-128.png src/renderer/assets/brand/tortie-128.png
